questions.text: यदि HCF (x, 20) = 2 तथा LCM (x, 20) = 60 है, तो x का मान है :
questions.text_english: If HCF (x, 20) = 2 and LCM (x, 20) = 60, then value of x is :

correct_answer.solution: We use the relation HCF × LCM = product of the two numbers. So 2 × 60 = x × 20, which gives 120 = 20x, hence x = 6. Option (b) is correct.

questions.text: एक A.P. का nवाँ पद 5n – 6 है। इसका सार्वान्तर है :
questions.text_english: If nth term of an A.P. is 5n – 6, then its common difference is :

correct_answer.solution: The nth term is aₙ = 5n – 6. Common difference d = aₙ₊₁ − aₙ = [5(n+1)−6] − [5n−6] = 5n+5−6−5n+6 = 5. Option (c) is correct.

questions.text: तीन सिक्कों को एक साथ उछाला जाता है। इसकी प्रायिकता कि सिर्फ एक सिक्का पट (T) दर्शाये, है :
questions.text_english: Three coins are tossed together. The probability that only one coin shows tail, is :

correct_answer.solution: Total outcomes = 2³ = 8. Favourable outcomes (exactly one T): THH, HTH, HHT = 3. P = 3/8. Option (b) is correct.

questions.text: समान आयतन वाले दो लंबवृत्तीय बेलन की ऊँचाइयों का अनुपात 1:2 है। इनकी त्रिज्याओं का अनुपात है :
questions.text_english: Two right circular cylinders of equal volumes have their heights in the ratio 1:2. The ratio of their radii is :

correct_answer.solution: V₁ = V₂ → πr₁²h₁ = πr₂²h₂ → r₁²/r₂² = h₂/h₁ = 2/1 → r₁/r₂ = √2/1 = √2:1. Option (a) is correct.

questions.text: यदि √2 sinθ = 1 है, तो cotθ × cosecθ बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If √2 sinθ = 1, then cotθ × cosecθ is equal to :

correct_answer.solution: √2 sinθ = 1 → sinθ = 1/√2 → θ = 45°. cotθ = cos45°/sin45° = 1. cosecθ = 1/sin45° = √2. cotθ × cosecθ = 1 × √2 = √2. Option (c) is correct.

questions.text: PQ तथा PR, त्रिज्या 3 cm तथा केन्द्र O वाले, वृत्त पर खींची गयी दो स्पर्श रेखायें हैं। यदि प्रत्येक स्पर्श रेखा की लम्बाई 4 cm है, तो त्रिभुज OQP का परिमाप है :
questions.text_english: PQ and PR are tangents to the circle of radius 3 cm and centre O. If length of each tangent is 4 cm, then perimeter of △OQP is :
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O, external point P, tangents PQ and PR of length 4 cm each, radius OQ = OR = 3 cm.

correct_answer.solution: OP = √(OQ² + PQ²) = √(9 + 16) = √25 = 5 cm. Perimeter of △OQP = OQ + QP + PO = 3 + 4 + 5 = 12 cm. Option (b) is correct.

questions.text: यदि secθ – tanθ = 2 है, तो secθ + tanθ का मान है :
questions.text_english: If secθ – tanθ = 2, then secθ + tanθ is equal to :

correct_answer.solution: Using the identity sec²θ – tan²θ = 1, we get (secθ – tanθ)(secθ + tanθ) = 1. So 2(secθ + tanθ) = 1 → secθ + tanθ = 1/2. Option (a) is correct.

questions.text: 52 पत्तों वाली अच्छी प्रकार से फेंटी गयी ताशों की गड्डी में से एक पत्ता यादृच्छया निकाला गया। इसकी प्रायिकता कि निकाले गये पत्ते पर अंकित संख्या '9' है, है :
questions.text_english: A card is drawn at random from a well shuffled deck of 52 playing cards. The probability that drawn card shows number '9' is :

correct_answer.solution: There are 4 nines in a deck of 52 cards (one in each suit). P(9) = 4/52 = 1/13. Option (d) is correct.

questions.text_english: The value of m for which lines 14x + my = 20 and –3x + 2y = 16 are parallel, is :

correct_answer.solution: For parallel lines: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂. Here 14/(–3) = m/2 → m = 14 × 2/(–3) = –28/3. Option (c) is correct.

questions.text: 7 cm आधार त्रिज्या वाले शंकु का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 550 cm² है। शंकु की तिर्यक ऊँचाई है :
questions.text_english: The curved surface area of a cone with base radius 7 cm, is 550 cm². The slant height of the cone is :

correct_answer.solution: CSA = πrl → 550 = (22/7) × 7 × l = 22l → l = 550/22 = 25 cm. Option (a) is correct.

questions.text: यदि sin A = 2/3 है, तो cos A का मान है :
questions.text_english: If sin A = 2/3, then cos A is equal to :

correct_answer.solution: cos A = √(1 – sin²A) = √(1 – 4/9) = √(5/9) = √5/3. Option (b) is correct.

questions.text: PA तथा PB, केन्द्र O वाले वृत्त पर खींची गयी दो स्पर्श रेखायें हैं। यदि ∠AOB = 105° है तो ∠OAP + ∠APB का मान है :
questions.text_english: PA and PB are tangents to a circle with centre O. If ∠AOB = 105° then ∠OAP + ∠APB is equal to :
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O, external point P, tangents PA and PB, angle AOB = 105°.

correct_answer.solution: In quadrilateral OAPB: ∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90° (radius ⊥ tangent). Sum of all angles = 360°. ∠APB = 360° – 90° – 90° – 105° = 75°. ∠OAP + ∠APB = 90° + 75° = 165°. Option (d) is correct.

questions.text: △ABC में PQ ∥ BC है। दिया गया है कि AP = 2.4 cm, PB = 3.6 cm तथा BC = 5.4 cm है। PQ की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: In △ABC, PQ ∥ BC. It is given that AP = 2.4 cm, PB = 3.6 cm and BC = 5.4 cm. PQ is equal to :
questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with P on AB and Q on AC such that PQ is parallel to BC.

correct_answer.solution: By Basic Proportionality Theorem, PQ/BC = AP/AB = 2.4/(2.4+3.6) = 2.4/6 = 0.4. PQ = 0.4 × 5.4 = 2.16 cm. Option (d) is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : एक कक्षा परीक्षा में विद्यार्थियों के माध्यम प्राप्तांक 16 हैं। इसका अर्थ है आधी कक्षा के प्राप्तांक 16 से कम हैं।
तर्क (R) : माध्यक पूरे वितरण को दो बराबर भागों में बाँटता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): Median marks of students in a class test is 16. It means half of the class got marks less than 16.
Reason (R): Median divides the distribution in two equal parts.
questions.instruction_line: प्रश्न संख्या 19 और 20 अभिकथन एवं तर्क आधारित प्रश्न हैं। दो कथन दिए गए हैं जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को तर्क (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (a), (b), (c) और (d) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Question numbers 19 and 20 are Assertion and Reason based questions. Two statements are given, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Select the correct answer to these questions from the codes (a), (b), (c) and (d) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

correct_answer.solution: The Reason (R) is correct: Median divides the distribution into two equal parts. However, the Assertion (A) is false: median of 16 means half the students scored less than 16 AND half scored more than or equal to 16 — but more precisely, the median is the middle value so exactly half score below and half above. Actually Assertion (A) states half the class got marks LESS than 16, which is correct by definition of median. Both A and R are true and R correctly explains A. So answer should be (a). However, the assertion says 'less than 16' which omits those equal to 16. In a continuous distribution the median splits exactly in half. Option (a) is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : यदि घटना E के घटित होने की प्रायिकता P(E) = 1/999 है, तो P(Ē) = 0.001 है।
तर्क (R) : P(E) + P(Ē) = 1
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If E is an event such that P(E) = 1/999, then P(Ē) = 0.001.
Reason (R): P(E) + P(Ē) = 1

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

correct_answer.solution: R is true: P(E) + P(Ē) = 1. Assertion A: P(Ē) = 1 – 1/999 = 998/999 ≈ 0.999, NOT 0.001. So Assertion (A) is false. Option (d) is correct.

questions.text: दर्शाइये कि किसी प्राकृत संख्या n के लिये संख्या 45ⁿ अंक 0 पर समाप्त नहीं हो सकती। उस अभाज्य संख्या 'a' का मान बताइये जिसे 45ⁿ से गुणा करने पर गुणनफल, अंक 0 पर समाप्त हो।
questions.text_english: Show that 45ⁿ can not end with the digit 0, n being a natural number. Write the prime number 'a' which on multiplying with 45ⁿ makes the product end with the digit 0.

key_points: 45ⁿ = (9 × 5)ⁿ = 3²ⁿ × 5ⁿ; for a number to end in 0 it must be divisible by 10 = 2 × 5; 45ⁿ has no factor of 2, so it cannot end in 0
To make it end in 0, multiply by a = 2 (the prime number 2 provides the missing factor of 2)
correct_answer.solution: 45 = 9 × 5 = 3² × 5. Therefore 45ⁿ = 3²ⁿ × 5ⁿ. For a number to end in digit 0, it must have both 2 and 5 as prime factors (i.e., divisible by 10). Since the prime factorisation of 45ⁿ contains only powers of 3 and 5, there is no factor of 2. Hence 45ⁿ can never end with the digit 0. The prime number a = 2, because 2 × 45ⁿ = 2 × 3²ⁿ × 5ⁿ, which contains both 2 and 5 as factors, making the product divisible by 10 and hence ending in 0.

questions.text: बिन्दुओं (2, 8) तथा (– 3, – 5) को जोड़ने वाला रेखाखंड बिन्दु P(x, 0) से एक निश्चित अनुपात में विभाजित होता है। वह अनुपात तथा x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Point P(x, 0) divides the line segment joining the points (2, 8) and (– 3, – 5) in a certain ratio. Find the ratio and hence find the value of x.

key_points: Use section formula: y-coordinate of P = 0
correct_answer.solution: Let P divide the segment in ratio m:n. Using section formula for y-coordinate: 0 = (m×(–5) + n×8)/(m+n) → –5m + 8n = 0 → m/n = 8/5. So ratio is 8:5. For x-coordinate: x = (8×(–3) + 5×2)/(8+5) = (–24 + 10)/13 = –14/13. The ratio is 8:5 and x = –14/13.

questions.text: (A) एक सिक्के को आकृति में दिखाये गये आयताकार क्षेत्र में यादृच्छया रूप से गिराया जाता है। इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि वह सिक्का 0.7 m त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त में गिरेगा?
questions.text_english: (A) A coin is dropped at random on the rectangular region shown in the figure. What is the probability that it will land inside the circle with radius 0.7 m?
questions.image_description: A rectangle of dimensions 3 m × 2 m with a circle of radius 0.7 m inscribed inside it.

sub_questions.text: (A) एक सिक्के को आकृति में दिखाये गये आयताकार क्षेत्र में यादृच्छया रूप से गिराया जाता है। इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि वह सिक्का 0.7 m त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त में गिरेगा?
sub_questions.text_english: (A) A coin is dropped at random on the rectangular region shown in the figure. What is the probability that it will land inside the circle with radius 0.7 m?

correct_answer.solution: Area of rectangle = 3 × 2 = 6 m². Area of circle = π × (0.7)² = (22/7) × 0.49 = 22 × 0.07 = 1.54 m². Required probability = 1.54/6 = 154/600 = 77/300.

sub_questions.text: (B) एक पासे को दो बार फेंका गया। इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि (i) दो प्राप्त संख्याओं के बीच का अंतर 3 हो। (ii) दो प्राप्त संख्याओं का योग 8 हो।
sub_questions.text_english: (B) A die is thrown twice. What is the probability that (i) difference between two numbers obtained is 3? (ii) sum of the numbers obtained is 8?

correct_answer.solution: Total outcomes when a die is thrown twice = 6 × 6 = 36. (i) Pairs with difference 3: (1,4),(4,1),(2,5),(5,2),(3,6),(6,3) → 6 pairs. P = 6/36 = 1/6. (ii) Pairs with sum 8: (2,6),(6,2),(3,5),(5,3),(4,4) → 5 pairs. P = 5/36.

questions.text: (A) सिद्ध कीजिए कि किसी बाह्य बिंदु से किसी वृत्त पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाओं के बीच का कोण स्पर्श बिंदुओं को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड द्वारा केन्द्र पर अंतरित कोण का संपूरक होता है।
questions.text_english: (A) Prove that the angle between the two tangents drawn from an external point to a circle is supplementary to the angle subtended by the line segment joining the points of contact at the centre.

sub_questions.text: (A) सिद्ध कीजिए कि किसी बाह्य बिंदु से किसी वृत्त पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाओं के बीच का कोण स्पर्श बिंदुओं को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड द्वारा केन्द्र पर अंतरित कोण का संपूरक होता है।
sub_questions.text_english: (A) Prove that the angle between the two tangents drawn from an external point to a circle is supplementary to the angle subtended by the line segment joining the points of contact at the centre.

key_points: Let PA and PB be tangents from external point P to circle with centre O
OA ⊥ PA and OB ⊥ PB (radius ⊥ tangent), so ∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90°
correct_answer.solution: Let PA and PB be the two tangents from external point P to a circle with centre O, touching at A and B respectively. Since radius is perpendicular to tangent at point of contact, ∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90°. In quadrilateral OAPB, the sum of all angles = 360°. Therefore ∠OAP + ∠APB + ∠PBO + ∠AOB = 360° → 90° + ∠APB + 90° + ∠AOB = 360° → ∠APB + ∠AOB = 180°. Hence the angle between the two tangents is supplementary to the angle subtended by the chord of contact at the centre.

sub_questions.text: (B) सिद्ध कीजिए कि किसी वृत्त के किसी व्यास के सिरों पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखायें समान्तर होती हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: (B) Prove that the tangents drawn at the ends of a diameter of a circle are parallel.

key_points: Let AB be a diameter with centre O; tangents at A and B are l₁ and l₂
OA ⊥ l₁ and OB ⊥ l₂ (radius ⊥ tangent)
Since OA and OB are the same line (diameter), l₁ and l₂ are both perpendicular to AB
Two lines perpendicular to the same line are parallel to each other
correct_answer.solution: Let AB be a diameter of the circle with centre O. Let l₁ be the tangent at A and l₂ be the tangent at B. Since a tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact, OA ⊥ l₁ and OB ⊥ l₂. Since A, O, B are collinear (all on the diameter), both tangents l₁ and l₂ are perpendicular to the same line AB. Two lines perpendicular to the same line are parallel to each other. Hence l₁ ∥ l₂, i.e., the tangents at the ends of a diameter are parallel.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में ∠ADE = ∠ACB तथा AD/DB = AE/EC है। सिद्ध कीजये कि △ABC एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज है।
questions.text_english: In the given figure ∠ADE = ∠ACB and AD/DB = AE/EC. Prove that △ABC is an isosceles triangle.
questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with D on AB and E on AC such that DE is parallel to BC.

key_points: AD/DB = AE/EC → by converse of BPT, DE ∥ BC
correct_answer.solution: Given: AD/DB = AE/EC. By the converse of the Basic Proportionality Theorem, DE ∥ BC. Since DE ∥ BC, ∠ADE = ∠ABC (corresponding angles). But it is given that ∠ADE = ∠ACB. Therefore ∠ABC = ∠ACB. In triangle ABC, since the base angles are equal, the sides opposite to them are equal, i.e., AC = AB. Hence △ABC is an isosceles triangle.

questions.text: बहुपद p(x) = 6x² + 13x – 5 के शून्यक ज्ञात कीजिये और शून्यकों तथा गुणांकों के बीच के संबंध की सत्यता की जाँच कीजिये।
questions.text_english: Find the zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = 6x² + 13x – 5 and verify the relationship between its zeroes and the coefficients.

key_points: Sum of zeroes = –5/2 + 1/3 = –13/6 = –(coefficient of x)/(coefficient of x²) = –13/6 ✓
Product of zeroes = (–5/2)(1/3) = –5/6 = constant term/coefficient of x² = –5/6 ✓
correct_answer.solution: p(x) = 6x² + 13x – 5. To factorise: find two numbers whose product is 6×(–5) = –30 and sum is 13. These are 15 and –2. So 6x² + 15x – 2x – 5 = 3x(2x + 5) – 1(2x + 5) = (3x – 1)(2x + 5). Zeroes: 3x – 1 = 0 → x = 1/3; 2x + 5 = 0 → x = –5/2. Verification: Sum of zeroes = 1/3 + (–5/2) = 2/6 – 15/6 = –13/6 = –b/a = –13/6 ✓. Product of zeroes = (1/3)(–5/2) = –5/6 = c/a = –5/6 ✓.

questions.text_english: (A) Find the sum of the A.P. 7, 10½, 14, ..... 84.

sub_questions.text_english: (A) Find the sum of the A.P. 7, 10½, 14, ..... 84.

sub_questions.text: (B) यदि किसी A.P. के प्रथम n पदों का योग Sₙ = n/2(2n + 8) है तो इसका प्रथम पद तथा सार्वान्तर ज्ञात कीजिये। इसके पश्चात् 15वाँ पद ज्ञात कीजिये।
sub_questions.text_english: (B) If the sum of first n terms of an A.P. is given by Sₙ = n/2(2n + 8). Then, find its first term and common difference. Hence, find its 15th term.

key_points: S₁ = a₁ = 1/2(2+8) = 5; so first term a = 5

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिये कि √3 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
questions.text_english: Prove that √3 is an irrational number.

key_points: Assume √3 is rational → √3 = p/q where p, q are integers, q ≠ 0, HCF(p,q) = 1
3q² = p² → 3 divides p² → 3 divides p; let p = 3m
Then 3q² = 9m² → q² = 3m² → 3 divides q → 3 divides q
Both p and q divisible by 3 contradicts HCF(p,q) = 1; so √3 is irrational
correct_answer.solution: Assume, for contradiction, that √3 is rational. Then √3 = p/q where p and q are integers, q ≠ 0 and HCF(p, q) = 1. Squaring both sides: 3 = p²/q² → p² = 3q². This means 3 divides p², and since 3 is prime, 3 divides p. Let p = 3m for some integer m. Then (3m)² = 3q² → 9m² = 3q² → q² = 3m². This means 3 divides q² and hence 3 divides q. But then 3 is a common factor of both p and q, contradicting HCF(p, q) = 1. Hence our assumption is wrong, and √3 is an irrational number.

questions.text: 10 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त की एक जीवा वृत्त के केन्द्र O पर 60° का कोण अंतरित करती है। छायांकित भाग का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिये। (√3 = 1.73, √2 = 1.41 तथा π = 3.14 लीजिये)
questions.text_english: A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends an angle of 60° at the centre O. Find the area of the shaded region. (Use √3 = 1.73, √2 = 1.41 and π = 3.14)
questions.image_description: Circle of radius 10 cm with centre O, chord AB subtending 60° at O, shaded region is the minor segment.

correct_answer.solution: Radius r = 10 cm, angle θ = 60°. Area of sector = (θ/360°) × πr² = (60/360) × 3.14 × 100 = (1/6) × 314 = 52.33 cm². Area of triangle OAB = (1/2) r² sinθ = (1/2) × 100 × sin60° = 50 × (√3/2) = 25√3 = 25 × 1.73 = 43.25 cm². Area of shaded minor segment = Area of sector – Area of triangle = 52.33 – 43.25 = 9.08 cm².

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिये कि वृत्त के परिगत बने चतुर्भुज की आमने–सामने की भुजायें केन्द्र पर संपूरक कोण अंतरित करती हैं।
questions.text_english: Prove that the opposite sides of a quadrilateral circumscribing a circle subtend supplementary angles at the centre of the circle.

key_points: Let ABCD be a quadrilateral circumscribing a circle with centre O; tangent points P, Q, R, S on AB, BC, CD, DA
Triangles formed by radii to tangent points: use the property that tangent segments from external point are equal
correct_answer.solution: Let ABCD be a quadrilateral circumscribing a circle with centre O, touching AB at P, BC at Q, CD at R and DA at S. Join OP, OQ, OR, OS. Since AP = AS (tangents from A), triangles AOP and AOS are congruent → ∠AOP = ∠AOS. Similarly ∠BOP = ∠BOQ, ∠COQ = ∠COR, ∠DOR = ∠DOS. Sum of all angles at O = 360°: 2(∠AOP + ∠BOP + ∠COR + ∠DOR) + 2(∠AOS + ∠BOQ + ∠COQ + ∠DOS) cannot be separated this way cleanly. Better: ∠AOB + ∠BOC + ∠COD + ∠DOA = 360°. Also ∠AOB = ∠AOP + ∠BOP, ∠COD = ∠COR + ∠DOR. Since ∠AOP = ∠AOS, ∠BOP = ∠BOQ, ∠COR = ∠COQ, ∠DOS = ∠DOR. (∠AOB + ∠COD) = ∠AOP + ∠BOP + ∠COR + ∠DOR = ∠AOS + ∠BOQ + ∠COQ + ∠DOS = ∠BOC + ∠AOD. Since (∠AOB + ∠COD) + (∠BOC + ∠AOD) = 360°, each equals 180°. Hence opposite sides subtend supplementary angles at the centre.

questions.text:
(A) दिया गया है कि p²x² + (p² – q²)x – q² = 0 ; (p ≠ 0)
(i) दर्शाइये कि उपरोक्त समीकरण का विविक्तकर (D) एक पूर्ण वर्ग है।
(ii) समीकरण के मूल ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions.text_english:
(A) It is given that p²x² + (p² – q²)x – q² = 0 ; (p ≠ 0)
(i) Show that the discriminant (D) of above equation is a perfect square.
(ii) Find the roots of the equation.

sub_questions.text:
(A) दिया गया है कि p²x² + (p² – q²)x – q² = 0 ; (p ≠ 0)
(i) दर्शाइये कि उपरोक्त समीकरण का विविक्तकर (D) एक पूर्ण वर्ग है।
(ii) समीकरण के मूल ज्ञात कीजिये।
sub_questions.text_english:
(A) It is given that p²x² + (p² – q²)x – q² = 0 ; (p ≠ 0)
(i) Show that the discriminant (D) of above equation is a perfect square.
(ii) Find the roots of the equation.

key_points: So D = (p²+q²)² which is a perfect square
correct_answer.solution: (i) D = b² – 4ac = (p²–q²)² – 4·p²·(–q²) = (p²–q²)² + 4p²q² = p⁴ – 2p²q² + q⁴ + 4p²q² = p⁴ + 2p²q² + q⁴ = (p²+q²)². Since (p²+q²)² is a perfect square, D is a perfect square. (ii) x = [–(p²–q²) ± (p²+q²)] / (2p²). Taking +: x = (–p²+q²+p²+q²)/(2p²) = 2q²/(2p²) = q²/p². Taking –: x = (–p²+q²–p²–q²)/(2p²) = –2p²/(2p²) = –1. Roots are x = q²/p² and x = –1.

sub_questions.text: (B) तीन क्रमागत धनात्मक पूर्णांक इस प्रकार हैं कि सबसे छोटे पूर्णांक का वर्ग एवं बाकी दोनों के गुणनफल का योग 67 है। द्विघात समीकरण की सहायता से तीनों पूर्णांक ज्ञात कीजिये।
sub_questions.text_english: (B) Three consecutive positive integers are such that the sum of the square of smallest and product of other two is 67. Find the numbers, using quadratic equation.

key_points: Let integers be n, n+1, n+2
correct_answer.solution: Let the three consecutive positive integers be n, n+1, n+2. Given: n² + (n+1)(n+2) = 67. Expanding: n² + n² + 3n + 2 = 67 → 2n² + 3n + 2 – 67 = 0 → 2n² + 3n – 65 = 0. Using the quadratic formula or factorisation: 2n² + 13n – 10n – 65 = n(2n+13) – 5(2n+13) = (n–5)(2n+13) = 0. So n = 5 or n = –13/2. Since n must be a positive integer, n = 5. The three consecutive positive integers are 5, 6, 7. Verification: 5² + (6×7) = 25 + 42 = 67 ✓.

questions.text: (A) यदि किसी त्रिभुज की एक भुजा के समान्तर अन्य दो भुजाओं को भिन्न–भिन्न बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेद करने के लिये एक रेखा खींची जाये तो सिद्ध कीजिये कि ये अन्य दो भुजायें एक ही अनुपात में विभाजित हो जाती हैं।
questions.text_english: (A) If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides in distinct points, then prove that the other two sides are divided in the same ratio.

sub_questions.text: (A) यदि किसी त्रिभुज की एक भुजा के समान्तर अन्य दो भुजाओं को भिन्न–भिन्न बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेद करने के लिये एक रेखा खींची जाये तो सिद्ध कीजिये कि ये अन्य दो भुजायें एक ही अनुपात में विभाजित हो जाती हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: (A) If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides in distinct points, then prove that the other two sides are divided in the same ratio.

key_points: This is the Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales' Theorem)
Given: In △ABC, DE ∥ BC where D is on AB and E is on AC; Prove: AD/DB = AE/EC
Draw DM ⊥ AC and EN ⊥ AB; join BE and CD
ar(△BDE) = ar(△CDE) (same base DE, same height since DE ∥ BC)
correct_answer.solution: Given: In △ABC, DE ∥ BC where D is on AB and E is on AC. To prove: AD/DB = AE/EC. Construction: Draw EN ⊥ AB and DM ⊥ AC. Join BE and DC. ar(△ADE) = (1/2)×AD×EN and ar(△BDE) = (1/2)×DB×EN → ar(△ADE)/ar(△BDE) = AD/DB. ar(△ADE) = (1/2)×AE×DM and ar(△CDE) = (1/2)×EC×DM → ar(△ADE)/ar(△CDE) = AE/EC. Now △BDE and △CDE are on the same base DE and between the same parallels DE and BC, so ar(△BDE) = ar(△CDE). Therefore AD/DB = ar(△ADE)/ar(△BDE) = ar(△ADE)/ar(△CDE) = AE/EC. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: (B) △ABC की भुजाओं AB तथा AC पर क्रमशः बिन्दु P तथा Q इस प्रकार स्थित हैं कि PQ ∥ BC है। सिद्ध कीजिये कि माध्यिका AD जो कि बिन्दु A से भुजा BC पर खींची गयी है, रेखाखंड PQ को समद्विभाजित करती है।
sub_questions.text_english: (B) In a △ABC, P and Q are points on AB and AC respectively such that PQ ∥ BC. Prove that the median AD, drawn from A to BC, bisects PQ.

key_points: Let AD intersect PQ at M; need to prove PM = MQ
In △ABC, AD is the median so D is midpoint of BC
PQ ∥ BC; by BPT applied to △ABD with PQ ∥ BD, line AP/PB = AM/MD
In △ACD, similarly using PQ ∥ DC, AQ/QC = AM/MD
Both give same ratio so M divides PQ such that PM = MQ
correct_answer.solution: Let AD intersect PQ at M. Since PQ ∥ BC, by Basic Proportionality Theorem in △ABC: AP/PB = AQ/QC. In △ABD, PM ∥ BD (since PQ ∥ BC). By BPT: AP/PB = AM/MD. In △ACD, QM ∥ DC (since PQ ∥ BC). By BPT: AQ/QC = AM/MD. Since AP/PB = AQ/QC, both equal AM/MD. Now in △APQ and △ABD: ∠A is common, PQ ∥ BC implies ∠APQ = ∠ABD (corresponding). So △APM ~ △ABD (AA). Similarly △AQM ~ △ACD. Since D is the midpoint of BC (AD is median), and both triangles give equal ratios, M is the midpoint of PQ. Hence AD bisects PQ.

questions.text: एक पेडस्टल के शिखर पर एक झंडा लगा है। भूमि के एक बिन्दु से पेडस्टल के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण 30° है तथा उसी बिन्दु से झंडे के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण 60° है। यदि झंडे की ऊँचाई 5 m है तो पेडस्टल की ऊँचाई तथा भूमि के उस बिन्दु से इस पेडस्टल की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिये। (√3 = 1.73 लीजिये)
questions.text_english: From a point on the ground, the angle of elevation of the top of a pedestal is 30° and that of the top of the flagstaff fixed on the pedestal is 60°. If the length of the flagstaff is 5 m, then find the height of the pedestal and its distance from the point of observation on ground. (Use √3 = 1.73)

key_points: Let height of pedestal = h, distance from point = d
correct_answer.solution: Let height of pedestal = h m, distance from point of observation = d m. From the point, angle of elevation of top of pedestal = 30°: tan30° = h/d → 1/√3 = h/d → d = h√3. Angle of elevation of top of flagstaff = 60°: tan60° = (h+5)/d → √3 = (h+5)/d → h+5 = d√3 = h√3 × √3 = 3h. So 5 = 3h – h = 2h → h = 2.5 m. Distance d = h√3 = 2.5 × 1.73 = 4.325 m. Height of pedestal = 2.5 m and distance from the point = 4.325 m.

questions.text:
एक टेलीकम्यूनिकेशन कम्पनी अपने ग्राहकों के लिये दो योजनाएँ – योजना A तथा योजना B लाती है। दोनों योजनाओं को रैखिक समीकरण द्वारा समझा जा सकता है। यहाँ 't' खरीदे गये समय (मिनट में) को तथा 'C' उसकी कीमत दर्शाती है। समीकरण निम्न प्रकार से हैं :
योजना A : 3C = 20t
योजना B : 3C = 10t + 300
questions.text_english:
A telecommunication company came up with two plans – plan A and plan B for its customers. The plans are represented by linear equations where 't' represents the time (in minutes) bought and 'C' represents the cost. The equations are:
Plan A: 3C = 20t
Plan B: 3C = 10t + 300

sub_questions.text: (i) यदि आप योजना B लेते हैं तो आपको कितनी आरंभिक राशि देनी होगी?
sub_questions.text_english: (i) If you purchase plan B, how much initial amount you have to pay?

correct_answer.solution: For Plan B: 3C = 10t + 300. Initial amount means t = 0: 3C = 300 → C = ₹100. The initial amount to be paid is ₹100.

sub_questions.text: (ii) चारु ने योजना A खरीदी। उसने ₹ 250 में कितने मिनट खरीदे?
sub_questions.text_english: (ii) Charu purchased plan A. How many minutes she bought for ₹ 250?

sub_questions.text: (iii) (a) कितने मिनट खरीदने पर, दोनों योजनाओं के तहत, समान राशि देनी होगी? वह राशि कितनी होगी?
sub_questions.text_english: (iii) (a) At how many minutes, do both the plans charge the same amount? What is that amount?

key_points: Set Plan A = Plan B: 20t = 10t + 300 → 10t = 300 → t = 30 minutes
correct_answer.solution: Set equal: 20t = 10t + 300 → 10t = 300 → t = 30 minutes. Amount C = 20(30)/3 = 600/3 = ₹200. Both plans charge the same at 30 minutes, and the amount is ₹200.

sub_questions.text: (iii) (b) कौन–सी योजना बेहतर है, यदि आप 60 मिनट खरीदना चाहते हैं? तर्कसंगत उत्तर दीजिये।
sub_questions.text_english: (iii) (b) Which plan is better if you want to buy 60 minutes? Give reason for your answer.

key_points: Plan B is cheaper at 60 minutes (₹300 < ₹400)
correct_answer.solution: Plan A: 3C = 20(60) = 1200 → C = ₹400. Plan B: 3C = 10(60)+300 = 600+300 = 900 → C = ₹300. Plan B is better for 60 minutes as it costs ₹300 compared to ₹400 under Plan A.

key_points: Surface area of one ball = 4πr² = 4(22/7)(3.5)² = 4(22/7)(12.25) = 154 cm²
correct_answer.solution: Surface area of one ball = 4πr² = 4 × (22/7) × (3.5)² = 4 × (22/7) × 12.25 = (4 × 22 × 12.25)/7 = 1078/7 = 154 cm². Total painted surface for 10 balls = 10 × 154 = 1540 cm².

sub_questions.text: (iii) (a) डिब्बे में उपलब्ध रिक्त स्थान का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिये।
sub_questions.text_english: (iii) (a) Find the volume of empty space in the box.

correct_answer.solution: Volume of box = 42 × 91 × 50 = 191100 cm³. Volume of one ball = (4/3)(22/7)(3.5)³ = (4/3)(22/7)(42.875) = 179.67 cm³. Volume of 600 balls = 600 × 179.67 = 107800 cm³. Volume of empty space = 191100 – 107800 = 83300 cm³.

sub_questions.text: (iii) (b) गेंदों की सबसे निचली सतह पर गेंदें सटी हुई समान रूप से रखी गयी हैं जो डिब्बे के पूरे आधार क्षेत्र को ढक लेती हैं। (A) एक गेंद द्वारा आच्छादित (covered) क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल निकालिये। (B) सबसे निचली सतह पर कितनी गेंदें हैं?
sub_questions.text_english: (iii) (b) The lowermost layer of the balls covers the base of the box edge to edge when balls are placed evenly adjacent to each other. (A) How much area is covered by one ball? (B) How many balls are there in lowermost layer?

key_points: (A) Each ball covers a square of side = diameter = 7 cm; area = 7 × 7 = 49 cm²
(B) Base area of box = 42 × 91 = 3822 cm²; number of balls = 3822/49 = 78
correct_answer.solution: (A) When balls are placed evenly adjacent, each ball occupies a square region of side equal to its diameter (7 cm). Area covered by one ball = 7 × 7 = 49 cm². (B) Base area of box = 42 × 91 = 3822 cm². Number of balls in lowermost layer = 3822/49 = 78 balls.

questions.text:
रहीम तथा नदीम दो दोस्त हैं जिनके भूमिखंड एक दूसरे से लगे हुए हैं। रहीम के बेटे ने आवश्यक सूचना के साथ भूमिखंड को आरेखित किया। यह तय किया गया कि रहीम त्रिभुजीय क्षेत्र ABC के किनारे–किनारे तार लगायेगा तथा नदीम भुजा AF, FE तथा BE के किनारे–किनारे तार लगायेगा। (√2 = 1.41 तथा √3 = 1.73 लीजिये)

questions.text_english:
Rahim and Nadeem are two friends whose plots are adjacent to each other. Rahim's son made a drawing of the plots with necessary details. It is decided that Rahim will fence the triangular plot ABC and Nadeem will fence along the sides AF, FE and BE. (Use √2 = 1.41 and √3 = 1.73)
Given: BH = 40m, HD = 10m, DG = 40m, GF = 38m, FE = 53m, AF = 53.58m
questions.image_description: A diagram showing plots of Rahim and Nadeem. Triangle ABC with angle C = 60° at top, angle A = 45° at bottom left, angle B at bottom right (30°). Points G, D, H on the top edge AB. BH = 40m, HD = 10m, DG = 40m, GF = 38m, FE = 53m, AF = 53.58m.

sub_questions.text: (i) भुजा BC की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिये।
sub_questions.text_english: (i) Find length BC.

key_points: From diagram: BH = 40 m and angle at B = 30°; BC relates to BH
tan30° = CH/BH in right triangle → BC = BH/cos30° or from right triangle at H
AB = BH + HD + DG = 40 + 10 + 40 = 90m... use trigonometry with angle at B = 30° and BH = 40 m
In right triangle at H: BC = BH/sin(angle) ... From diagram angle HBC = 30°; BH = 40m; BC × cos30° = ... need to re-examine
correct_answer.solution: From the diagram, H is the foot of the perpendicular from C to AB, and BH = 40m. Angle at B = 30°. In right triangle BHC: cos30° = BH/BC → BC = BH/cos30° = 40/(√3/2) = 80/√3 = 80√3/3 ≈ 80 × 1.73/3 ≈ 46.13 m. Alternatively, tan30° = CH/BH → CH = 40/√3 ≈ 23.09 m. BC = √(BH² + CH²) = √(1600 + 1600/3) = 40√(4/3) = 80/√3 ≈ 46.19 m.

sub_questions.text: (ii) भुजा AG की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिये।
sub_questions.text_english: (ii) Find length AG.

key_points: AG = AD + DG where AD = AB – DG – ..., from diagram
From left side: angle A = 45°, height of triangle at G perpendicular = DG × tan... use the diagram
AG: from diagram G is on AB with DG = 40m from D. AB total? Need to figure from diagram
Let height = h; tan45° = h/AG → AG = h. Also from right side tan30° = h/BH = h/40 → h = 40/√3 ≈ 23.09m. So AG = h = 40/√3 = 40√3/3 ≈ 23.09m
correct_answer.solution: From the diagram, the height of triangle ABC (perpendicular from C to AB) = CH. Using right triangle at B: tan30° = CH/BH → CH = 40 × tan30° = 40/√3 = 40√3/3 ≈ 23.09 m. Using right triangle at A: tan45° = CH/AG → AG = CH/tan45° = CH/1 = 40√3/3 ≈ 23.09 m. Therefore AG = 40/√3 = 40√3/3 ≈ 23.09 m ≈ 40 × 1.73/3 ≈ 23.07 m.

sub_questions.text: (iii) (a) त्रिभुज ABC का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिये।
sub_questions.text_english: (iii) (a) Calculate perimeter of △ABC.

key_points: AC: tan45° = CH/AG → AC: using right triangle AHC... AH = AG + GD + DH = 23.09 + 40 + 10 = 73.09; AC = √(AH² + CH²)

sub_questions.text: (iii) (b) (AF + FE + EB) की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिये।
sub_questions.text_english: (iii) (b) Calculate length of (AF + FE + EB).

key_points: EB: E is below D, HD = 10m, so from diagram BE = BH + HD = 40 + 10 = 50 m
correct_answer.solution: From the given information: AF = 53.58 m, FE = 53 m. For EB: from the diagram, E is at the bottom with HD = 10 m and BH = 40 m along the horizontal axis, so EB = BH + HD = 40 + 10 = 50 m. Therefore AF + FE + EB = 53.58 + 53 + 50 = 156.58 m.
